title: Estagiário de Investimentos & Vendas
description:
Sobre a EREA:

A EREA é hoje a consultoria de Real Estate logístico mais inovadora do mercado e está entrando em um novo ciclo de crescimento. Nossa trajetória e jeito de ser são definidos por sonhos ambiciosos que nos trouxeram até este ponto e que nos enchem de orgulho. No entanto, acreditamos que o momento de evoluir é sempre o agora e, para nós, isso significa trazer pessoas nas quais reconhecemos potencial, e nas quais investiremos nosso tempo e esforços para desenvolver. Eles se tornarão nossos líderes no futuro.

Nossa cultura valoriza o que nos trouxe até aqui, mas também reconhece a importância de olhar para o futuro. Nosso setor está passando por mudanças fundamentais e a EREA é pioneira nesse movimento. Acreditamos que o foco no cliente, investimentos nas pessoas e tecnologia serão fatores determinantes para as melhores empresas de Real Estate da próxima década.

Para continuarmos nessa jornada de evolução coletiva, convidamos você a fazer parte dela. Prazer, somos a EREA e adoraríamos te ter com a gente.


Sobre a vaga:

Estamos com uma vaga aberta para estágio na área de Investimentos e Vendas, com foco em análise de ativos, desmobilização de carteiras, estruturação de operações imobiliárias e relacionamento com investidores. Buscamos estudantes de faculdades de primeira linha, com forte interesse em Real Estate, perfil analítico, comunicativo, hands-on e com vontade de crescer em um ambiente dinâmico e meritocrático.

Principais Responsabilidades        

.• Controles associados à carteira de clientes

• Apoio na elaboração de Memorandos de Oferta, análise de viabilidade econômica de imóveis (modelagem econômico-financeira) e operações estruturadas (via diferentes veículos)

• Monitoramento e pesquisa de mercado, contribuindo com estratégias comerciais

• Elaboração de propostas comerciais para aquisição e venda de ativos, participações societárias e veículos de investimento

• Apoio na produção de relatórios gerenciais de performance do time comercial

• Interação com parceiros, clientes e investidores

Requisitos Obrigatórios    

• Estudantes de graduação em Economia, Administração, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas, a partir do 3º ano

• Interesse e/ou envolvimento com o setor de Real Estate

• Conhecimentos essenciais em: Excel avançado

▪ Noções Básicas: CRIs, FIIs e estruturação de SPEs

▪ Noções básicas societárias

▪ Noções básicas de tributação aplicada ao mercado imobiliário

• Boa comunicação, perfil proativo e orientação comercial

• Domínio de PowerPoint

• Disponibilidade para estagiar de 20 a 30 horas semanais


Porque a pessoa deveria deixar o trabalho atual para vir para esta posição    

Ambiente dinâmico e desafiador, dentro de um setor promissor no Brasil.

title: ANALISTA PLANEJAMENTO COMERCIAL SR
description:
Somos o grupo educacional mais diversificado do país. Todos os dias, criamos futuros incríveis através da inovação. Colocamos a mão na massa para tirar as ideias do papel e colocá-las em prática. Enfrentamos desafios com resiliência e nos adaptamos às mudanças constantes.


Por aqui, somos um time e não heróis, guiados pela vontade de fazer a diferença e conectados de um só jeito, o #JeitoCogna. Nossa relação é direta e respeitosa, e o sucesso dos nossos alunos e clientes é o nosso sucesso.


Além disso, valorizamos a diversidade, porque sabemos que quanto mais diverso é o nosso repertório, mais abrangente e inclusivo seremos. Juntos impulsionamos as pessoas a construírem uma melhor versão de si! E aí, bora fazer parte da empresa líder absoluta do segmento educacional? Vem pra Cogna.


Como será seu dia a dia:


Você fará parte do time de Planejamento, atuando diretamente no desdobramento de metas e na apuração dos resultados dos canais de captação de matrículas. No dia a dia, será responsável por acompanhar o desempenho dos canais e vendedores, garantindo a correção das remunerações variáveis (RVs) e a consistência dos indicadores de performance.

Além das rotinas de apuração, você também irá contribuir com a análise de resultados e geração de insights, identificando oportunidades de melhoria e crescimento nos canais, modalidades e períodos de captação.

Essa posição tem um papel importante na evolução analítica da área, ajudando o time a sair do operacional e avançar para análises mais estratégicas, com projeções, recomendações e inovação — seja através de automações, modelos preditivos ou novas formas de olhar os dados.

Buscamos alguém proativo, analítico e com autonomia, capaz de entender os processos, buscar informações e propor soluções sem depender de direcionamentos constantes.



Responsabilidades e atribuições:

• Desenvolver e gerenciar o calendário comercial, alinhando sazonalidades e oportunidades para impulsionar a captação;

• Monitorar e analisar o posicionamento da concorrência, avaliando estratégias de precificação, diferenciais e comunicação;

• Identificar tendências de mercado e oportunidades de captação, fornecendo insights ao time comercial;

• Ser ponto focal do time comercial com a área de marketing, garantindo que as demandas sejam atendidas com agilidade;

• Criar e manter um dashboard de competitividade por região;

• Criar briefings para as áreas de marketing e acompanhar a criação de materiais e conteúdos comerciais (folders, apresentações, e-mails, materiais digitais, roteiros de vendas);

• Monitorar a performance das campanhas comerciais, sugerindo ajustes para otimizar conversão e engajamento do time de vendas;

• Criar e disponibilizar guias e treinamentos sobre diferenciais competitivos para os consultores de vendas.

Requisitos e qualificações:

• Ensino superior completo em Administração, Economia, Marketing ou áreas correlatas;

• Experiência em planejamento comercial, inteligência de mercado ou trade marketing;

• Habilidade para gestão de múltiplas demandas e interface com áreas de vendas e marketing;

• Habilidade avançada em Excel e ferramentas de BI (Power BI ou similares);

• Boa comunicação verbal e escrita, com habilidade para produzir apresentações claras e objetivas;

• Proativo, organizado e com foco em execução e impacto em resultados;

• Analítico e orientado por dados, mas com visão prática para transformar análises em ações comerciais.

Informações adicionais:


Modelo de trabalho híbrido (2x na semana presenciais)

Temos alguns escritórios espalhados pelo Brasil, mas você ficará alocado na Paulista.


O que você pode esperar da gente?

  • Participação nos lucros: resultados com comemoração fazem parte do jeito Cogna.
  • Vale-refeição ou alimentação: num cartão de benefícios flexível.
  • Assistência médica: um abrangente plano de saúde, com inclusão de dependentes e coparticipação.
  • Assistência odontológica: está disponível para manter seu sorriso.


Mas espera, ainda tem mais!

  • Bolsas de estudo de graduação e pós graduação: nossas unidades de ensino para que você e seus dependentes (cônjuge e filhos).
  • Day off no aniversário: você poderá escolher um dia para relaxar e celebrar.
  • Convênio SESC: abre as portas para as inúmeras oportunidades de melhora na qualidade de vida.
  • Convênio farmácia Univers: descontos numa variedade de medicamentos.
  • Universidade corporativa: diversas trilhas e cursos gratuitos na nossa universidade corporativa para você seguir evoluindo com a gente.
  • Descontos em livros: para você adquirir os melhores títulos em nossas editoras.
  • Wellhub (Gympass): para que você possa se movimentar no seu dia a dia.
  • Programa Ninho: Um programa dedicado às nossas famílias que estão aguardando um novo bebê.
  • Valoriza - Programa de Recrutamento Interno: Para impulsionar sua carreira por meio de oportunidades internas.


Aqui, acreditamos no respeito, na diversidade e na busca da inclusão em todas suas frentes. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados independentemente de raça, gênero, identidade, expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, genética, deficiência ou de qualquer outra base.

Nosso propósito é avançar cada vez mais, gerando empregabilidade para talentos diversos. Venha enriquecer nosso time!

title: Analista Logística SR (Otimização Prazo)
description:
Desafio da Posição, será realizar análises estratégicas de prazos e performance para garantir a melhor experiência de entrega ao cliente.


Responsabilidades

  • Liderar e conduzir análises detalhadas de Prazo Visto, Prazo Realizado e ofertas D+1.
  • Calcular o impacto e os efeitos (CD, transporte, performance de adicionais e eventos atípicos) para cada malha logística e canal de vendas (1P e 3P).
  • Liderar e executar projetos de transformação e/ou melhoria contínua em processos logísticos, garantindo a entrega de resultados tangíveis.
  • Criar, implementar e monitorar KPIs de logística, assegurando a precisão dos dados e o acompanhamento de metas.
  • Gerar apresentações executivas claras e assertivas para comunicar insights, resultados de análises e propostas de melhoria para a gestão.


Requisitos

  • Superior completo em áreas correlatas (Engenharia, Ciência da Computação, Estatística, Economia).
  • Experiência em análises e manipulação de grandes volumes de dados, preferencialmente no segmento de Logística ou E-commerce.
  • Domínio em planilhas (Excel ou Google Sheets) e ferramentas de BI (Tableau e/ou Looker)
  • Conhecimento intermediário em SQL.
  • Atuação em São Paulo (Vila Guilherme) e ocasionalmente no CD de Louveira/SP (2 vezes ao mês)
  • Diferencial experiência em projetos de melhoria contínua (Lean)


Aqui, temos atitude de dono e com alto nível de exigência para si e para os demais, encarando as dificuldades como oportunidades. Somos “mão na massa”, com trabalho duro e sempre tomando decisões baseadas em dados, fatos e intuição.


Buscamos sempre ser simples e inovadores, desafiamos premissas existentes, sempre propondo abordagens melhor e sem medo de errar. Para nós, o cliente está sempre em 1º lugar. Colocamos o seu interesse final, sempre à frente de nossas ações e decisões. Temos muita paixão por vender, servir e encantar. Afinal, nosso principal valor e ser “Gente que gosta de Gente”!!!

title: Analista de Recursos Humanos (Benefícios) - PCD
description:

Buscamos constantemente aprimorar nossos processos e, principalmente, oferecer condições que promovam saúde, equilíbrio e satisfação para quem faz parte da nossa jornada.

  • Ambiente inclusivo, colaborativo e comprometido com o desenvolvimento profissional;
  • Remuneração competitiva e benefícios que valorizam seu bem-estar;
  • Cultura orientada à transparência, respeito e crescimento contínuo;
  • Oportunidades de participação em projetos estratégicos;

Através de um grande estudo de mercado, uma administração rígida e uma logística coesa, foi criado o nosso segmento de vendas atacado, abrangendo todo território nacional.

title: Cabotage Coordinator
description:
Cabotage Coordinator

Job Title: Cabotage Coordinator

Location: São Paulo, Brazil

Terms: Full Time. On site.

Compensation: Commensurate with experience, the individual’s, and the team’s performance.

Company:

Sky Fusion Global Supply Chain focus on global dry bulk shipping and Industrial Projects Logistics. Headquartered in Singapore, we have settled filiales in China, Morocco, South Africa, Australia, Brazil, USA, Germany, and continues to be a globally expanding group.


Our Core Business:

  • Global Dry Bulk Freight
  • Industrial Projects Logistics & Renewable Energy Supply Chain Innovation


For more information, you may check our website：


Role

Sky Fusion is seeking the right candidate to fill a key role, the new Cabotage Coordinator. The primary focus of this role is the coordination of bids for Brazilian Flag impelled cargo opportunities. These are cargoes that will move within the Brazilian territory.

The coordinator will be tasked with evaluating and pursuing both commercial and operational cargoes for carriage on the Company’s Brazil Flag vessels. The scope of these cargo bids may often require extension of the scope to include use of multimodal forms of conveyance.

Candidates are encouraged to think outside of the box. There are always new challenges on the horizon and ways to improve, even in a business as old as shipping.

This position will challenge the coordinator to come up with creative solutions by matching multiple fleet schedules and modes of transportation with various bids. This role will require constant interaction and communication with the Client’s team to ensure the successful execution of projects.


Responsibilities & Duties

a. Identification and pursuit of chartering opportunities for wind projects.

b. Voyage calculations and pricing of both near‐term and long‐term project cargoes.

c. Analysis of intermodal bids (commercial).

d. Administration of quoting system. Emphasis on visibility within team and timely communications with

customers.

e. Project monitoring

f. Tracking Wind Cargo Flows (Historic & Projected)


Requirements & Skills

a. Ability to multi‐task

b. Understanding of terms and conditions for contracts of carriage and carriage of breakbulk cargoes under Brazilian Cabotage legistlation.

c. Strong verbal and written communication skills

d. Attention to detail.

e. Minimum of bachelor’s degree (preferably in a Maritime Business Administration or Transportation).

f. Minimum three (3) years of experience in the Fluvial / Caoastal cabotage transportation industry is preferred but candidates with les experience will still receive consideration.


Personal Characteristics

Ambitious | Enthusiastic | Team player

title: Analista de Controles Internos e Conformidades Jr
description:
A inovação e o pioneirismo sempre fizeram parte da nossa história, que começou em 1980. Temos o DNA de varejo, já que nascemos da Pernambucanas – marca centenária que sempre contou com os serviços financeiros para apoiar as famílias brasileiras de maneira fácil e democrática. Ao longo dos anos, as soluções evoluíram e se diversificaram, permitindo à Pefisa se consolidar no mercado financeiro.

Somos responsáveis pelo desenvolvimento e gestão de produtos como cartões, empréstimo pessoal, seguros e a conta digital, com diferenciais como simplicidade, praticidade e sem burocracia. Prezamos por bons relacionamentos, pelo atendimento próximo e por jogar junto.

Com mais de 5 milhões de clientes ativos e grande relevância na área do varejo, disponibilizamos um amplo portfólio de serviços para pessoas físicas e jurídicas, além de um Banking as a Service (BaaS) para marcas de diversos segmentos. Com isso, adotamos iniciativas inovadoras para clientes e parceiros.

Na Pefisa tudo é simples. Tudo é rápido. Te ajudamos com o que você precisa para realizar seus sonhos ou alavancar seu negócio. E você escolhe como quer conversar, pois nós somos Fígital. Atuamos com a melhor experiência entre o físico e o digital, com nossas plataformas digitais ou através de nossas lojas físicas. Somos a fintech pra gente como a gente.


Analista de Controles Internos e Conformidades Jr (Foco RO, Compliance e CI)


Requisitos:

  • Superior completo em em Administração, Direito, Economia, Contabilidade, Engenharia ou áreas e áreas correlatas;
  • Conhecimento de produtos e serviços bancários, especialmente do Varejo Bancário (Seguros, Conta Digital, Cartões e Operações de Crédito);
  • Conhecimento sobre Direito do Consumidor e normas regulatórias associadas aos produtos supracitados;
  • Experiência prévia em Riscos Operacionais, Compliance, Controles Internos, Auditoria ou Riscos Não Financeiros;
  • Perfil analítico, orientado a dados, detalhista, curioso e proativo;
  • Habilidade de comunicação, questionamento e proposta de soluções;
  • Habilidade em administrar múltiplas demandas com prioridade baseada em risco;
  • Domínio das ferramentas do pacote Office.


Atividades:

  • Mapear os processos, riscos, controles e produtos da Pefisa, visando antecipar e identificar potenciais riscos operacionais e regulatórios (Metodologia COSO, Risk Self Assessment , etc.);
  • Atuar proativamente na identificação, análise, avaliação, controle e mitigação dos riscos inerentes aos processos que a empresa está exposta, possibilitando a evolução contínua da maturidade da cultura de riscos.
  • Controlar e propor mitigantes de risco, visando reduzir perdas operacionais, com ênfase em: falhas operacionais, contingências cíveis e gestão de fraudes.
  • Analisar e emitir pareceres, sob a ótica de riscos operacionais e regulatórios, para os processos e produtos financeiros da Pefisa.
  • Prestar apoio aos gestores do negócio na elaboração e follow-up dos planos de ação para mitigação de riscos identificados nos trabalhos internos e externos.
  • Apoiar na construção de indicadores, dashboards e materiais que suportem à administração quanto aos temas de Gestão de Riscos Operacionais e de Conformidade.
  • Apoiar na elaboração de relatórios regulatórios (Resolução CMN 4.968/21, circular nº 3978/20, 4.595/17, Resolução nº 4.595/17, etc.)
  • Atendimento às demandas da auditoria (interna e externa) e reguladores.


Será considerado diferencial:

  • Experiência com analytics, através do desenvolvimento de indicadores e monitoramento continuo utilizando ferramentas, tais como: Vertex, CoPilot, Python, Knime, Powerbi, DataBricks, SQL e outras;
  • Conhecimento de normas BCB e relatórios regulatórios (Resolução CMN 4.968/21, Circular BC nº 3978/20, Resolução CMN 4.595/17, Resolução CMN nº 4.557/17, etc.);
  • Conhecimento de Gestão Integrada de Riscos e Declaração de Apetite a Risco (RAS – Risk Appetite Statement).

Acreditamos na força dos talentos que preparamos. Eles transformam de fato, impactam organizações, impulsionam mais talentos e criam oportunidades. Que tal fazer parte da maior organização de serviços profissionais do mundo?

Escolha seu impacto .

Queremos que você coloque em prática todo o seu talento e desenvolva uma carreira de sucesso com a gente, com equilíbrio entre Mente, Corpo e Propósito. Preparar e elaborar relatórios gerenciais, realizando levantamentos de informações financeiros e andamento de trabalhos e resultados alcançados, visando a disponibilização de informações estratégicas para acompanhamento dos indicadores e tomada de decisão.

title: ANALISTA PREVENÇÃO RISCOS E FRAUDES PL
description:
Resumo da Vaga:

O Analista de Prevenção a Riscos e Fraudes Pleno será responsável por investigar denúncias e suspeitas de fraudes no Grupo Petrópolis, recebidas pelo Canal de Conduta e outros meios oficiais. O profissional atuará de maneira imparcial, ética e legal, visando identificar e esclarecer fatos, fraudes de colaboradores e terceiros. O foco é fornecer informações cruciais para a tomada de decisões dentro dos parâmetros legais, normas e procedimentos internos, além de apoiar o jurídico nas análises dos casos.



OBJETIVOS:

Avaliação de Denúncias e Demandas:

  • Analisar e avaliar denúncias de fraudes oriundas do Canal de Conduta e outros meios oficiais, identificando os procedimentos a serem adotados e contribuindo com informações para decisões internas.

Investigações Sistêmicas:

  • Realizar investigações utilizando sistemas internos, envolvendo públicos internos e externos, para detectar violações legais, políticas e procedimentos. Identificar oportunidades de ações corretivas nos processos da empresa contribuindo para melhoria contínua.

Investigações em Campo:

  • Conduzir investigações, com diligências e contato com testemunhas e envolvidos, coletando evidências (vídeos, fotos, depoimentos, relatórios) para subsidiar a investigação.

Elaboração de Relatórios:

  • Preparar relatórios detalhados com os resultados das investigações, identificando falhas ou não conformidades e informando as áreas pertinentes, como o departamento jurídico.
  • Atualização Constante:

Manter-se atualizado quanto às normas e procedimentos internos relativos às investigações e prevenção a fraudes.

  • Apoio à Gestão:

Auxiliar na criação de materiais e apresentações para reporte à gestão, além de apoiar na elaboração e revisão de diretrizes e procedimentos do departamento.



DIFERENCIAIS:

title: Jr Front End Angular Developer with Java
description:
Vaga Afirmativa para Mulheres


Language: English & Portuguese

Position: Hybrid, 3x in Office located in Alphaville

We are seeking a Junior Front-End Developer specializing in Angular, with experience integrating Java-based backend services. This role is ideal for professionals passionate about building user interfaces for scalable web applications and collaborating with backend teams.

  • Ensure cross-browser compatibility and responsive design using HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, and JavaScript.
  • Utilize tools like Node.js, Jenkins, OpenShift, and Autosys as needed.
  • Conduct unit testing using Jasmine and Karma.
  • Manage source code using Git and track tasks/issues with JIRA.
  • Collaborate in Agile/Scrum environments and participate in sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.
  • Work with MongoDB/Oracle databases when required.
  • Maintain high standards of code quality, system design, and architecture.
  • Communicate effectively with business stakeholders and technical teams.
  • Support successful project implementations.
  • Adapt quickly to changing priorities and project needs.


Qualifications:

  • Up to 4 years of experience in front-end development.
  • Hands-on experience with Angular (version 8 or above), preferably Angular 14+.
  • Proficiency in JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, JSON, and Ajax.
  • Experience with RxJS and reactive programming.
  • Experience integrating Java-based backend APIs (Spring Boot).
  • Experience with micro frontend architecture and component library creation.
  • Knowledge of Jasmine & Karma for testing.
  • Experience with SCM tools like Git and project management tools like JIRA.
  • Agile/Scrum methodology experience.
  • Experience with MongoDB or Oracle databases is an advantage.
  • Strong analytical, design, and architecture skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Proven ability to support and deliver successful projects.

description:

title: Country Manager (Legal, Brasil)
description:
Hello!



We are looking for an experienced and proactive Country Manager to join our global legal team and lead enforcement efforts in Brazil.


You’ll work closely with global legal and business teams, directly protecting the rights of some of the world's most recognized brands.


This is a role with complete ownership for driving our expansion in Brazil.


We need a manager with a legal background who knows how to create processes from scratch in a startup environment, rather than an established corporation. The ideal candidate will effectively lead people, design and scale operations, and be highly results-driven.


Who are we?



BrandMonitor is a global legal-tech company focused on the protection of intellectual property rights across the world. We proudly represent over 450 international brands across industries like fashion, luxury goods, electronics, and more — in their fight against counterfeiting and IP violations.

Our legal operations span Europe, Asia, MENA and Latin America , and we are now expanding our legal team in China .



What you will do:



  • Be responsible for meeting the revenue plan and the target number of enforcement actions (purchases, claims, and lawsuits);
  • Achieve operational profitability for the project;
  • Rebuild the team, organize rapid onboarding, and ensure the team achieves target performance indicators;
  • Develop operational and hiring regulations for project scaling (increasing the number of protected brands, successful cases, and compensation amounts);
  • Negotiate with counterfeit sellers and ensure compliance with settlement agreements and court decisions;
  • Organize regular, predictable seizures of counterfeit goods with law enforcement agencies in the region;
  • Ensure the legality of all activities and provide accurate reporting to the government and the head office.



What we expect from you:


  • Degree in Law / Experience in a management position at a law firm;
  • Project management experience 2-3 years;
  • Experience in building processes from scratch;
  • Knowledge of Intellectual Property - an advantage;
  • Leadership, responsibility, decision-making ability, multitasking skills;
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English B2.



What We Offer


  • Work with top-tier global clients and international teams;
  • Competitive salary;
  • Opportunity to lead and shape legal operations in the region;
  • Remote-first setup with flexibility;
  • Real impact on the global fight against counterfeit trade.
  • We’re building the future of IP protection — fast, smart and global.



Join us at BrandMonitor and help us grow stronger by hiring the people who’ll make it happen.

About Us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to transform food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage.

In less than one year, Keeta became an industry leader in Hong Kong, China. Soon after, we expanded into Saudi Arabia and are now present in more than 20 cities. Following our recent successful launch in Qatar, Kuwait and the UAE, we're bringing that same speed and innovation to more of the Middle East, and to Brazil.


Job Responsibilities

  1. Team Management and Deliverables: Responsible for managing a local Keeta team of approximately 30-40 people in Brazil, responsible for uploading and verifying all merchant information, ensuring data efficiency, completeness, and accuracy. This requires balancing limited resources and delivering high-quality team results on time.
  2. Mechanism and Process Development: Establish comprehensive internal and external collaboration workflows and oversight mechanisms, continuously optimizing processes to ensure the team accurately and efficiently serves business needs.
  3. Core Metric Monitoring: Monitor and report key onboarding metrics, proactively identify and resolve issues to ensure a smooth onboarding experience for merchants.

  5. Team Development and Capacity Building: Develop training materials and conduct onboarding training for new employees and merchants as needed.


Job Requirements

  1. Highly responsible and unwaveringly committed to achieving goals and results.
  2. Effective in resource management and problem-solving.
  3. A strong learner, eager to continuously acquire new skills and adapt to a constantly changing business environment.
  4. A proactive team player who supports colleagues and enhances team efficiency through excellent communication skills.
  5. Native Portuguese speaker, fluent in English (listening, speaking, reading, and writing).
  6. Experience in merchant operations support is preferred.


Why Join Keeta

Keeta is redefining the future of food delivery with a bold vision and innovative spirit. As a fast-scaling brand under Meituan's global ambition, we offer a unique blend of stability and startup energy, providing boundless opportunities for personal and professional growth. Whether you want to specialize in your field or gain cross-functional experience, Keeta empowers you to take charge of your career.

As we expand globally, we are committed to building a workplace that reflects our unique culture while incorporating global best practices. You'll be part of a company that's transforming the delivery industry while supporting local communities, empowering merchants, and delivering outstanding customer experiences.

At Keeta, you'll collaborate with a passionate and pragmatic global team across over 57 countries, bringing diverse perspectives that drive creativity and innovation. We believe diversity is our strength and it pushes us to deliver better solutions for our customers and partners in Hong Kong, Saudi Arabia, and beyond.

Keeta offers limitless career growth and equal development opportunities, empowering you to grow as the company grows. Every day presents an opportunity for you to make a meaningful impact, grow professionally, and be part of something extraordinary. You'll thrive in a dynamic environment where every contribution is valued. Together, let's build the future of food delivery.

Then there's a full pre-sales team who are there to support you with everything from client assessments, recommendation documentation and software demonstrations

title: Strategy and Planning Expert
description:
What You'll Do

Position Summary

We are seeking a highly strategic and analytical Strategy & Planning Expert to join our team and lead the business evolution of our Innovation vertical. This role is responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing the business model, managing the end-to-end P&L, and serving as the Project Management Office (PMO) for key implementation projects. The ideal candidate will have a strong blend of strategic vision, financial acumen, and operational process design skills to drive sustainable growth and profitability.

Key Responsibilities

  • Business Model Evolution : Design and continuously evolve the business model for the Innovation vertical, including market entry strategies, new service offerings, and go-to-market approaches.
  • P&L Management : Own and manage the P&L for the vertical, including financial forecasting, budget planning, and variance analysis. Identify and execute initiatives to improve profitability and top-line growth.
  • Strategic Planning : Develop and lead the strategic planning process for the vertical, identifying market trends, competitive threats, and growth opportunities. Translate strategy into actionable, measurable plans.
  • PMO for Implementation : Serve as the Project Management Office for all strategic initiatives and key implementation projects within the vertical. Define project scope, manage timelines, track progress, and ensure projects are delivered on time and within budget.
  • Process Design & Improvement : Design, map, and implement new business processes to improve operational efficiency, scalability, and performance. Conduct root cause analysis to identify process bottlenecks and drive continuous improvement.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including Operations, Product, Sales, and Marketing, to ensure alignment on strategy and execution.
  • Stakeholder Management : Communicate project updates, financial performance, and strategic direction to key stakeholders, including senior leadership.
  • Performance Analysis : Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure business model health, project success, and operational effectiveness.


What We Need From You

  • Education : Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Finance, or a related field. An MBA or advanced degree is highly desirable.
  • Experience : Proven experience in a strategy, planning, business development, or management consulting role, with significant experience in P&L management and process design. Experience in the Food Delivery sector is a plus.
  • Strategic Acumen : Strong ability to think strategically, analyze complex business problems, and develop innovative solutions.
  • Analytical Skills : Highly analytical and data-driven, with strong financial modeling and forecasting skills.
  • Project Management : Expertise in project management methodologies and tools, with experience managing complex, cross-functional projects.
  • Process Design : Experience in mapping, designing, and optimizing business processes.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels.
  • Leadership : A self-starter with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to drive change in a fast-paced environment.

title: Associate Teacher, Primary Division
description:
Company Description

Welcome to Avenues São Paulo! Since our doors opened in August 2018, we've been on a mission to provide a truly transformative educational experience. Through immersive English language learning and dynamic interdisciplinary projects, we prepare our students to become future worldwise leaders uniquely equipped to understand and solve global-scale problems. As part of the Nord Anglia Education network, we're proud to stand alongside Avenues New York, shaping the future of education together. With a vibrant community of over 1100 students, ranging from as young as 18 months old through to graduation, our campus buzzes with a culture of innovation, creativity, collaboration, and state-of-the-art technology. Join us as we embark on a journey of lifelong learning and growth and discover why there's no place quite like Avenues São Paulo.


Job Description


Deep Collaboration, Constant Evolution

Collaboration here isn't a buzzword: it's woven into everything we do. At Avenues, no one teaches on an island. Substantial time to collaborate is embedded into the schedule. Teacher teams, across multiple disciplines, design learning experiences together for a whole grade level. This intensity of collaboration is challenging as well as exciting: we're always evolving, learning from each other and seeking to improve.


Language Immersion

Avenues students will graduate fluent in a second language and at ease beyond their borders. To this end, in grades N-1 students will be in a full English immersion program and from grades 2-5, Portuguese will take on a prominent place in the classroom.

As an Avenues Associate Teacher, you will:

  • Support lead teachers to develop and teach curriculum across multiple subjects that engages all learners in meaningful, challenging work that cultivates 21st-century skills
  • Help ensure that all students achieve key learning outcomes for the grade level, targeting instruction thoughtfully to address individual needs
  • Build a robust learning atmosphere that leads students to value being at school and feel part of a rigorous but joyful learning community
  • Collaborate intensively and daily with colleagues to continually improve student learning and school culture
  • Participate actively in ongoing, intensive professional learning


Qualifications

  • Student teaching, teacher training or equivalent experience with children ages 3-8
  • Deep dedication to learning and developing the craft of teaching
  • Highly effective collaborator, eager to listen deeply, contribute to a team and achieve goals together
  • Very resourceful and adaptive, eager to embrace constant change, growth and learning
  • Bachelor’s degree required, master’s degree preferred


Additional Information

Avenues is deeply committed to diversity, equity and inclusion throughout our organization. We strive to uphold a culture in which every colleague feels that they belong, are trusted, and are valued. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, and strongly encourage candidates from traditionally underrepresented communities or groups to apply. Avenues offers competitive compensation and a generous benefits package.

Avenues upholds the highest standards for safeguarding the physical and emotional wellbeing of children. As an essential aspect of this commitment, all offers are contingent upon successful completion of careful reference and background checks.

title: Manager, Paperboard Sales (Americas), APRIL
description:
About APRIL

Asia Pacific Resources International Limited (APRIL) Group is one of the world’s leading producers of pulp and paper, known for technological excellence, efficiency, and sustainable forest management. Our flagship PaperOne™ brand and other products are used daily in packaging, printing, and writing applications, and sold in over 70 countries. With operations in Riau Province, Sumatra, Indonesia, APRIL employs around 9,000 people directly and supports more than 90,000 livelihoods through its wider ecosystem, contributing to sustainable growth and community development.


More details of APRIL at:


About the Role

Paperboard Sales Manager (Americas) will develop APRIL’s commercial growth across North and Latin American markets. The role focuses on executing sales plans, developing customer accounts, and expanding APRIL’s market footprint for its paperboard products. Working closely with the regional and global sales teams, the incumbent will drive day-to-day sales activities, monitor market trends, and strengthen customer relationships to achieve sustainable growth and profitability.


Key Responsibilities


Sales Execution & Market Development

  • Responsible for sales activities and achievement of sales targets for the paperboard business.
  • Implement regional sales plans and achieve volume, revenue, and margin targets.
  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities across assigned markets.
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with customers, distributors, and channel partners.


Account Management & Customer Service

  • Manage assigned key accounts, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction.
  • Coordinate with internal teams to ensure timely order fulfilment, delivery, and payment collection.
  • Support resolution of customer issues and service improvement initiatives.


Market Intelligence & Reporting

  • Track market trends, competitor activity, and pricing movements.
  • Prepare regular sales reports, forecasts, and insights to support management decisions.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align market insights with business priorities.


Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

  • Work closely with supply chain, logistics, and finance teams to ensure smooth execution.
  • Support regional marketing or promotional initiatives to strengthen brand presence.
  • Participate in trade shows, customer visits, and business reviews as required.


Job Requirements


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Engineering, or Science; MBA preferred.
  • 6–10 years of sales experience in the paperboard, packaging, or related materials industry .
  • Experience in managing customer accounts across North or Latin America.
  • Strong communication skills in English; proficiency in Spanish or Portuguese is an advantage.


Skills & Competencies

  • Sales and account management capability.
  • Strong commercial acumen and pricing awareness.
  • Negotiation and customer-engagement skills.
  • Analytical mindset with ability to interpret market data.
  • Collaboration across multicultural teams.
  • Resilience and adaptability in a dynamic environment.


Personal Characteristics

  • Results-oriented and self-driven, with high ownership and accountability.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build trust-based relationships.
  • Resilient and adaptable in fast-paced, multicultural environments.
  • High integrity, professionalism, and alignment with RGE’s values and sustainability principles.

title: Analista de Sinistros Pleno
description:
SOBRE A SEDGEWICK:

Cuidar das pessoas está no centro de tudo o que fazemos, e começamos cuidando de você, nosso valioso colaborador. Uma carreira na Sedgwick significa entrar em contato com nossa cultura de cuidado. Significa ter flexibilidade e tempo para todas as coisas que são importantes para você. É uma oportunidade de fazer algo significativo todos os dias. É ter apoio para suas necessidades mentais, físicas, financeiras e profissionais. Significa aprimorar suas habilidades e desenvolver sua carreira. E isso significa trabalhar em um ambiente que celebre a diversidade e seja justo e inclusivo.


Uma carreira na Sedgwick é onde a paixão encontra o propósito de gerar um impacto positivo no mundo por meio das pessoas e organizações que servimos. Se você é uma pessoa motivada a fazer a diferença, que gosta de desafios e, acima de tudo, é uma pessoa que se importa, há um lugar para você aqui. Junte-se a nós e contribua para que a Sedgwick seja um ótimo lugar para trabalhar.


Great Place to Work®

Top 100 Most Loved Workplace®

Melhor empregador do estado de acordo com a Forbes



OBJETIVO PRINCIPAL: Realizar todas as etapas de um processo de regulação de sinistros. Seus principais objetivos incluem garantir uma resposta eficiente e eficaz aos sinistros relatados pelos segurados, assegurando uma resolução justa e satisfatória para todas as partes envolvidas. Atuar na análise detalhada das circunstâncias do sinistro, na avaliação dos danos e na determinação das coberturas aplicáveis à apólice de seguro. Conduzir as comunicações com os segurados, corretores, agentes e outros envolvidos no processo, esclarecendo dúvidas, fornecendo orientações e negociando acordos quando necessário. O Analista de Sinistros também trabalha em estreita colaboração com outras áreas internas, como jurídico, financeiro e atendimento ao cliente, para resolver pendências e garantir a conformidade com as políticas e regulamentações do setor de seguros. Suas atividades envolvem desde a coleta inicial de informações sobre o sinistro até a conclusão do processo, incluindo a liquidação de valores de indenização e o encerramento do caso de forma satisfatória para todas as partes. Este profissional tem um maior foco técnico, com uma relação mais profunda com as etapas de Regulação de Sinistros.


FUNÇÕES E RESPONSABILIDADES ESSENCIAIS:


  • Receber e registrar notificações de sinistros relatados por segurados, corretores ou agentes, e realizar uma análise inicial das circunstâncias do sinistro (pré-análise)
  • Conduzir investigações detalhadas sobre a validade e a extensão do sinistro, incluindo a avaliação de danos, coleta de evidências e entrevistas com testemunhas, quando necessário.
  • Realizar vistoria remota assistida através das tecnologias da Sedgwick coletando imagens para compor o laudo/processo do Sinistro, de acordo com as especificidades de cada ramo, condições gerais do produto e determinações dos Clientes.
  • Determinar a aplicabilidade das coberturas da apólice ao sinistro reportado, verificando os termos, condições e limitações da apólice de seguro.
  • Estabelecer comunicação com os segurados para fornecer orientações sobre o processo de regulação de sinistros, esclarecer dúvidas e solicitar documentação adicional, quando necessário.
  • Negociar acordos e resoluções com os segurados, corretores, agentes ou terceiros envolvidos no sinistro, com o objetivo de alcançar uma solução justa e satisfatória para todas as partes, quando aplicável ao escopo contratado pelos Clientes da Sedgwick.
  • Solicitar e coletar documentos relevantes relacionados ao sinistro, como registros médicos, estimativas de reparo, relatórios policiais e outros documentos necessários para a análise e avaliação do sinistro, de acordo com a documentação exigida por cada Cliente para as coberturas dos produtos comercializados.
  • Determinar a responsabilidade das partes envolvidas no sinistro e avaliar os impactos na resolução do sinistro, considerando as leis, regulamentos, condições gerais do produto, coberturas e demais aspectos do sinistro que está sendo analisado, resultando em um pagamento total, parcial ou a uma negativa de indenização.
  • Avaliar os danos causados pelo sinistro e determinar os valores de indenização de acordo com as coberturas da apólice e os procedimentos estabelecidos pela Seguradora.
  • Preparar relatórios detalhados sobre a investigação, análise e resolução do sinistro, documentando todas as etapas do processo e as decisões tomadas, de acordo com o Book de Regras de cada Cliente da Sedgwick.
  • Monitorar e gerenciar pendências relacionadas aos sinistros em aberto, garantindo que sejam resolvidas de forma oportuna e eficiente, buscando apoio das áreas internas da Sedgwick, Seguradora ou Corretora e/ou buscando solucionar pendências junto ao cliente, como por exemplo a obtenção de documentação complementar.
  • Registrar todas as atividades, decisões e informações relevantes sobre os sinistros nos sistemas de gerenciamento de sinistros da Sedgwick e/ou dos Clientes, garantindo a precisão e a integridade dos dados.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com outras áreas internas, como jurídico, atendimento ao cliente, financeiro e etc, para resolver questões e pendências relacionadas aos sinistros, buscando sua solução com a maior qualidade possível no menor tempo possível.
  • Acompanhar o progresso e o status dos processos de regulação de sinistros, fornecendo atualizações regulares aos segurados e outras partes interessadas conforme determinado no Book de Regras de cada Cliente, de acordo com as respectivas réguas de comunicação pré-estabelecidas assim como os canais disponíveis.
  • Garantir que todas as atividades e decisões relacionadas à regulação de sinistros estejam em conformidade com as leis, regulamentação SUSEP, condições gerais do produto e suas respectivas coberturas e especificidades determinadas pelos Clientes da Sedgwick formalizadas em um Book de Regras.



FUNÇÕES E RESPONSABILIDADES ADICIONAIS:

  • Executar análise e solucionar pendências.
  • Avaliar circunstâncias do sinistro e coberturas reclamadas vs coberturas contratadas
  • Obter informações e evidências relevantes (como vistorias e/ou documentos complementares)
  • Atender KPI's e SLA's e identificar oportunidade de melhorias.
  • Realizar acompanhamentos, buscar soluções e acionar áreas Internas da Sedgwick ou do Cliente dependendo da situação apresentada no contato, objetivando compartilhar o caso e buscar apoio com a solução de pendências.



REQUISITOS


Educação e licenças

  • Superior Completo ou Cursando: Administração, Negócios ou Correlatas, Ciências Atuariais, Economia ou Finanças ou Correlatas, Desenvolvimento de Sistemas, Ciências da Computação ou Correlatas, Gestão de Seguros ou Gestão de Riscos ou Direito ou Engenharia.
  • Diferencial caso possua Certificações SUSEP.


Experiência

  • Mínimo de 2 anos de experiência em uma posição similar atuando em um dos ramos: Responsabilidade civil (RC), Riscos Nomeados e Compreensivo empresarial.
  • Experiência anterior em BPO's, seguradoras ou corretoras
  • Compreensão detalhada das políticas de seguros, incluindo termos, condições, coberturas e exclusões das apólices, para determinar a aplicabilidade ao sinistro.
  • Conhecimento em técnicas de investigação para coletar evidências, realizar entrevistas e verificar informações relacionadas ao sinistro.
  • Capacidade de interpretar e analisar documentos legais relevantes para o sinistro, como apólices de seguro, relatórios policiais, registros médicos, contratos de locação entre outros.
  • Gerenciamento de documentos, incluindo verificação de integridade, organização e indexação adequada dos documentos
  • Conhecimento das leis e regulamentos que regem a indústria de seguros, incluindo legislação de seguros, responsabilidade civil, proteção ao consumidor e privacidade de dados.
  • Nível Intermediário – Pacote Office, com ênfase em Excel
  • Nível de Inglês Intermediário será considerado diferencial


Habilidades (Pleno) em:

  • Gestão do Tempo
  • Integração e Trabalho em Equipe
  • Empatia
  • Habilidade de Comunicação Assertiva
  • Pensamento Analítico
  • Proatividade e postura resolutiva
  • Multitarefa, Organização, Adaptabilidade e Flexibilidade

A Prisma acredita que essa abordagem multiestratégia é fundamental para a geração de retornos não correlacionados com os ciclos macroeconômicos brasileiros.

Responsabilidade:

  • Controle das carteiras (Divulgação de cotas, reconciliação de informações divulgadas pelo administrador, validação de cálculos);
  • Suporte a áreas internas (Relatórios para investidores, fornecimento de informações regulatórias);
  • Suporte ao processo de auditoria dos fundos e revisão de demonstrações financeiras;
  • Controle de cotistas (Reconciliação das posições, análise de distribuições, chamadas de capital etc.);

  • Excel avançado;

description:

JOB DESCRIPTION

The Product Owner (PO) for the Revenue Management System (RMS) is responsible for shaping and delivering integrated solutions that support pricing, demand forecasting, and revenue optimization. This role involves managing initiatives that span data engineering, machine learning, and user-facing interfaces. In addition to gathering and managing business requirements, the PO will be responsible for overseeing the full delivery lifecycle to ensure successful execution from concept through release.


DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Develop and maintain a backlog of features and enhancements spanning data pipelines, predictive models, and RMS user interfaces.

Identify and prioritize high-value opportunities to optimize pricing strategies and demand forecasting.

Gather, analyze, and document business requirements and translate them into detailed epics and user stories with clear descriptions, business rules, and acceptance criteria.

Own the full delivery lifecycle of features and enhancements, ensuring timely execution, alignment with stakeholders, and readiness for deployment.

Collaborate with Data Engineering on requirements for data sourcing, integration, and quality.

Partner with Data Science to define, deploy, and iterate on ML models and pricing algorithms.

Align with UI/UX and front-end teams to ensure a seamless user experience.

Facilitate cross-functional workshops and planning sessions with business stakeholders.

Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to assess product success and user adoption.

Ensure accurate documentation in Confluence and Jira for themes, epics, and tasks.

Coordinate with QA to validate features and ensure delivery meets requirements.

Promote continuous iteration based on stakeholder feedback and performance data.

Drive change management and support user training for new RMS features.

Ensure compliance with data governance, security, and regulatory standards.

Identify and mitigate risks associated with process and system changes.

Actively participate in Agile ceremonies including backlog grooming, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.

Perform other job-related functions as assigned.


QUALIFICATIONS

DEGREE TYPE:

Bachelor's Degree


FIELD(S) OF STUDY:

Business Management, Data Analytics, or related fields


EXPERIENCE;

  • At least 3 years of experience in end-to-end product ownership, product management, or delivery of data or optimization platforms.
  • Experience working across Data Engineering, Data Science, and UI Development teams, as well with multiple stakeholders and brand Revenue Management teams.
  • Experience working in Agile software development environments with cross-functional teams.
  • Industry experience in cruise, travel, or enterprise data systems is a plus.


COMPETENCIES/SKILLS

  • Exposure to revenue management, pricing systems, or forecasting tools is preferred
  • Strong understanding of Agile delivery methodologies and iterative development
  • Familiarity with data pipelines, ML model lifecycle, and modern UI patterns
  • Ability to define and refine user stories across technical and business domains
  • Proficient in Jira, Confluence, and backlog management tools
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Excellent facilitation, documentation, and analytical skills
  • Understanding of change management principles and user adoption strategies
  • High attention to detail and ability to manage competing priorities
  • Strong business acumen and problem-solving capabilities
  • Adaptability in fast-paced, cross-functional environments


CERTIFICATIONS/LICENSES

Add certifications/licenses (if any) here.

  • Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or similar Agile certification preferred
  • Product Management or Lean Six Sigma certification is a plus

  • Políticas & Compliance: criar/atualizar políticas (uso de equipamentos, reembolsos, conduta, LGPD para RH), termos de ciência e fluxos de aprovação.
  • Indicadores (People Analytics): acompanhar KPIs (tempo de contratação, turnover, absenteísmo, custo de pessoal, NPS do colaborador, aderência a treinamentos) e apresentar relatórios gerenciais.

Requisitos

  • Experiência prévia generalista em RH (R&S + DP/folha/interface), preferencialmente em PMEs ou ambientes com operação fabril/ateliê e times comerciais.

Diferenciais (bons de ter)

  • Noções de LGPD aplicada ao RH e SST .
  • Ter estruturado do zero políticas, trilhas de onboarding/T&D e ciclos de desempenho.

O que oferecemos

title: Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor Role
description:
Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor


Downstream · Open to employees in Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Guyana, Paraguay, Peru, Suriname, Uruguay, Venezuela


About Downstream


Downstream is transforming the construction industry by building a marketplace for equipment rentals, portable toilets, and roll-off dumpsters. We are scaling fast. Our vision: bring price transparency, automation, and intelligence into one of the most manual, underserved verticals in the economy.


We’re inspired by clean design and modern architecture—and we’re pushing forward with AI-native product thinking, not bolting it on later.


The Role


We’re hiring a Head of Product Design (UI/UX) who is obsessed with creating intuitive, elegant, and impactful user experiences. You’ve shipped something before—whether at a startup that scaled, a product that users loved, or a platform that redefined a workflow. You know the pain of turning complex problems into simple, usable solutions, and you want another shot at shaping an industry from 0 → 1.


At Downstream, you’ll work directly with our CEO, CTO, and Product team to:

  • Define and own the design vision for our marketplace, supplier tools, and customer experience.
  • Lead end-to-end design for web and mobile, including UX flows, UI systems, and visual identity.
  • Architect AI-native product experiences that feel intuitive, not artificial—helping users trust automation and agents in critical workflows.
  • Collaborate with engineers and product managers to ship fast: prototype, test, iterate, and refine.
  • Build and scale our design system so we can move quickly without sacrificing quality.


Responsibilities

  • Drive the product design strategy across customer, supplier, and internal platforms.
  • Build and maintain UI/UX standards that reflect simplicity, trust, and efficiency.
  • Design AI-native experiences—where agentic systems interact seamlessly with users, data, and decisions.
  • Conduct user research and usability testing with construction industry stakeholders.
  • Mentor and grow a design team as we scale.


What We’re Looking For

  • Battle-tested designer: You’ve shipped real products (startup, marketplace, SaaS, or similar).
  • AI-forward mindset: You don’t just add AI—you design around it, making it feel natural and empowering.
  • Builder’s DNA: Comfortable with ambiguity, speed, and iteration. You’ve felt the pain of building in the real world and still want more.
  • Technical & design skills:
  • UI/UX design (Figma, Sketch, or equivalent)
  • Strong UX research and prototyping chops
  • Design systems and component libraries
  • Understanding of modern frontend frameworks (bonus: Flutter, React)
  • Experience designing for AI interactions (chat, agents, workflows)
  • Startup mentality: Hands-on, resourceful, willing to go beyond your job title.
  • Industry experience: Construction tech or marketplaces a huge plus—someone who can empathize with our users.


Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in marketplaces, logistics, SaaS, or fintech.
  • Familiarity with B2B workflows and procurement tools.
  • Contributions to open-source design systems or AI products.


Why Downstream

  • Early-stage, high-growth startup with real traction.
  • Work with a small, sharp, and ambitious product + engineering team.
  • Opportunity to shape AI-native product experiences in an industry that hasn’t seen this level of innovation before.
  • Competitive salary + equity

title: Data Warehouse Architect
description:
Databricks Data Warehouse Architect About the role:

One of the largest companies in the world in the Gaming industry is seeking a hands-on Data Architect with DataWarehouse Engineer expertise in Databricks (DBX) and AWS-native data services to spearhead the design and implementation of a new data warehouse instance for a major product line. This role will involve building from the ground up—architecting scalable pipelines, optimizing lakehouse performance, and integrating seamlessly with diverse real-time and batch data sources across AWS.

The ideal candidate is passionate about data architecture , thrives in fast-moving environments, and has a proven track record of setting up high-performance lakehouse platforms on Databricks with a strong foundation in data warehousing principles .

Key Responsibilities:
  • Design and deploy a new Databricks Lakehouse instance tailored to the client’s product-level data needs.
  • Architect and implement robust data ingestion pipelines using Spark (PySpark/Scala) and Delta Lake.
  • Integrate AWS-native services (S3, Glue, Athena, Redshift, Lambda) with Databricks for optimized performance and scalability.
  • Define data models, optimize query performance, and establish warehouse governance best practices.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product teams, data scientists, and DevOps to streamline data workflows.
  • Maintain CI/CD, preferably DBX for data pipelines using GitOps and Infrastructure-as-Code.
  • Monitor data jobs and resolve performance bottlenecks or failures across environments.
Required Skills & Experience: Databricks / Lakehouse Architecture
  • End-to-end setup of Databricks workspaces and Unity Catalog
  • Expertise in Delta Lake internals , file compaction, and schema enforcement
  • Advanced PySpark/SQL skills for ETL and transformations
AWS Native Integration
  • Deep experience with AWS Glue , S3 , Redshift Spectrum , Lambda , and Athena
  • IAM and VPC configuration knowledge for secure cloud integrations
Data Warehousing & Modeling
  • Strong grasp of modern dimensional modeling (star/snowflake schemas)
  • Experience setting up lakehouse design patterns for mixed workloads
Automation & DevOps
  • Familiarity with CI/CD for data engineering using tools like DBX, Terraform, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps
  • Proficient in monitoring tools like CloudWatch, Datadog, or New Relic for data pipelines
Bonus/Nice to Have:
  • Experience supporting gaming or real-time analytics workloads
  • Familiarity with Airflow , Kafka , or EventBridge
  • Exposure to data privacy and compliance practices (GDPR, CCPA)
Other Details:
  • Location : Latin America (LATAM) region - Remote, USA - Remote
  • Length : 1+ Year

Client : Gaming giant

title: Product Owner (PO) Técnico/Analista de Negocios Sr
description:
Product Owner, PO Técnico ou Analista de Negócios Sênior

INGLES FLUENTE



  • Experiência comprovada como Product Owner, PO Técnico ou Analista de Negócios Sênior em projetos de modernização de dados, Business Intelligence ou APIs.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia em migração de dados de sistemas legacy para cloud (AWS, GCP ou Azure).
  • Conhecimento em plataformas de crédito ou antifraude.
  • Experiência na definição de KPIs (Key Performance Indicators) para monitoramento de qualidade de dados (Data Quality).


Resumo do Cargo

Buscamos um Product Owner (PO) Técnico altamente motivado para liderar a frente de consumo de dados e relatórios dentro da workstream de modernização. O PO será a ponte essencial entre as necessidades de negócio e a complexidade técnica da integração de dados em arquiteturas cloud-native . O foco principal é garantir que os relatórios sejam construídos com precisão e eficiência, utilizando dados provenientes de sistemas legados migrados e do Data Fabric global.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Gestão do Produto (Relatórios e Dados):
  • Definir, priorizar e manter o backlog de recursos (funcionalidades e histórias de usuário) necessários para o consumo de dados do Data Fabric e a construção dos relatórios finais.
  • Atuar como stakeholder primário para validação de entregas técnicas e de negócio.
  • Especialista em Integração e API:
  • Profundo conhecimento no consumo de dados via API , definindo padrões de requisição e resposta para payloads complexos.
  • Conhecimento prático em GraphQL é mandatório, sendo responsável por desenhar as queries mais eficientes para extração e composição dos dados no Orquestrador de Relatórios.
  • Trabalhar ativamente com o time de Engenharia para definir os schemas de dados e a governança de APIs.
  • Qualidade e Migração de Dados:
  • Liderar a fase de análise de dados migrados de sistemas legados para a nuvem , garantindo a integridade, a qualidade e a equivalência das informações.
  • Definir e coordenar a execução de Testes de Equivalência (Equivalence Testing) para garantir que os relatórios construídos na nova arquitetura (Data Fabric) correspondam exatamente aos resultados do sistema legado.
  • Colaboração Técnica e Operacional:
  • Colaborar diretamente com os Data Stewards e times de Engenharia de Dados para entender a origem, o tratamento e a disponibilização dos dados no Data Fabric.
  • Liderar o discovery e o refinamento de requisitos complexos, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis e performáticas.

title: Key Account Manager
description:
ompany Overview:

  • Language Skills: Full professional proficiency in both Portuguese and English is mandatory.

  • Cultural Affinity: Experience working with or for a Chinese company is a significant advantage.
  • Personal Attributes: A self-starter with a strong sense of initiative, excellent resilience under pressure, and a genuine enthusiasm for embracing change and challenges. You must be a quick learner who can rapidly apply new knowledge to your work.

  • A pivotal role in the expansion of a globally recognized and beloved brand.
  • A dynamic, fast-paced, and supportive international work environment.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package.

  • Comprometimento e transparência

title: Head of Charging
description:
About Vammo


Vammo is building an accessible, resilient, and scalable clean energy network for emerging megacities, starting in Latin America. By combining electric motorcycle subscriptions with a rapidly expanding battery swap infrastructure, we make clean transportation affordable and reliable for the millions who keep cities moving.


Founded in 2022 and headquartered in São Paulo, Vammo has raised $100M from top-tier investors across the globe. Our founders and team represent an incredibly diverse and international group that is built of former executives coming from Tesla, Uber, Rappi, iFood, Loggi, Niu, Jump and others. We are all deeply motivated by the mission to decarbonize Latin America while simultaneously reducing costs for one of the region’s most vulnerable populations.


The next wave of mobility innovation will come not from San Francisco, but from São Paulo. Our operations will soon expand from Sao Paulo to cities across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia, proving that real climate impact and transformative business models can be built first where the need is greatest.


About the role


As the Head of Charging Operations, you will be the executive leader responsible for defining and executing the strategy for the reliability, efficiency, and scalability of Vammo's battery-swapping network which is the heart of our customer experience.


Reporting directly to the Founders, you will build and lead the organization that ensures not only the expansion of our charging network, but also its 24/7 operation. You will be the ultimate owner of this network efficiency and quality, managing the LiveOps, Field Operations, and Commercial Charging Teams, being responsible for preparing the area for 10x growth. This is a mission-critical leadership role that demands strategic vision, the ability to build high-performance teams, and a deep sense of ownership.


What You'll Do

  • Define the end-to-end Charging Ops strategy, including the detailed strategic plan and OKRs. Own the design of processes, systems, and team architecture required to scale the operation by 10x, improve efficiency, and increase customer satisfaction.
  • Own the area's full budget and P&L, managing and optimizing costs to meet company goals.
  • Define and monitor the area's core OKRs and KPIs.
  • Recruit, develop, and lead high-performing teams across LiveOps, Field Operations, and Infrastructure. Define the area's vision and culture, focusing on urgency, accountability, and data-driven problem-solving.
  • Serve as the ultimate owner of network uptime, reliability, and incident response, ensuring riders always have batteries available.
  • Own the end-to-end energy strategy to reduce cost per kWh, including managing procurement, exploring free market (Mercado Livre) opportunities, and implementing efficiency initiatives.
  • Lead the commercial and expansion strategy for the network, defining site selection criteria to secure prime locations and network balance, negotiating strategic partnerships, and overseeing installation/launch playbooks.
  • Build proactive Customer Experience (CX) processes to communicate downtime and protect our NPS.
  • Serve as the strategic voice of operations for the Product and Engineering teams, providing real-world feedback and guiding the hardware/software roadmap to improve operability.
  • Act as the final escalation point for critical incidents, conduct post-mortems, and implement structural changes to prevent recurrence.


What We're Looking For

  • 8-12 years professional experience
  • Excellent knowledge of Brazil and Latin American business practices
  • Track record of scoping, building, training and leading large multidisciplinary teams
  • Proven expertise in process design, optimization, and creating Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for large-scale operation
  • An analytical and strategic mindset, with strong data-driven decision-making skills and experience defining OKRs
  • Executive communication and influencing skills, capable of aligning tech, executive, and field teams.
  • Excels in planning and executing initiatives of varying durations and scales while effectively managing stakeholders.
  • Fosters collaborative and respectful work environments
  • Technical Curiosity, a drive to understand how systems, hardware, and data truly work and how to optimize them.
  • Experience in high-growth (hyper-growth) startups
  • Experience managing 24/7 systems.
  • Experience setting and leading priorities, objectives and strategic direction for entire orgs
  • Experience in mobility, energy, logistics, IoT, or telecommunications is a plus.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese.
  • Strong alignment with the company’s values


Benefits

  • A leadership role at fast-growing startup changing the face of mobility in Latin America, backed by some of the best venture capitalists in the world
  • Working at a mission driven company - we are reducing carbon emissions across the world and putting more money into the pocket of disenfranchised populations
  • Being surrounded by a talented and ambitious team that wants to build something big 
  • Freedom to take on as much responsibility as you dare, allowing you to develop quickly
  • Competitive salary package
  • Opportunity to own a piece of the company - equity package
  • Health Insurance

title: Enterprise Architect
description:
Join one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!


Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for a Enterprise Architect , who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract, hybrid , in the city of São Paulo .


In this role you will:

The Enterprise Architect will be centrally responsible for the strategic definition and implementation of Canada's enterprise architecture, working from the design and governance of systems to the integration of technological platforms and operational mining processes. Its mission is to translate business objectives into modern, secure and scalable architectures, aligned with international standards and the automation, sustainability and innovation goals of the group.

This professional will work in partnership with the global Enterprise Architect and cross-functional areas (IT, Operations, Engineering, ESG), ensuring that each solution offers efficient integration between on-premises, cloud, and industrial automation environments. He will have a profound influence on technology decisions, playing an advisory role with Canadian and Brazilian leadership, promoting a collaborative, innovative and results-oriented environment.

To succeed, you must demonstrate strategic vision, technical leadership, exceptional intercultural communication skills, and mastery of regulatory requirements in both Canada and Brazil.


Main Responsibilities

  • Define, document and evolve integrated Enterprise Architecture models (business, applications, data, technology), using frameworks such as TOGAF/ArchiMate and aligning with the strategic demands of mining, sustainability and digital transformation.
  • Act as a technical reference, leading cross-functional teams, promoting the consolidation of solutions between IT, OT and industrial automation, ensuring adherence to global corporate standards.
  • Evaluate and validate new technologies, platforms, services and methods (Cloud, Edge Computing, Digital Twins, IoT, Analytics, Cybersecurity), always considering the best practices in the mineral and natural resources sector.
  • Develop and maintain architectural criteria that prioritize security, regulatory compliance (LGPD, PIPEDA, GDPR), performance, sustainability and operational integration between Canada and Brazil.
  • Prepare detailed documentation (LLD/HLD, reference architectures, guidelines), transferring knowledge and mentoring technical and business teams both locally and internationally.
  • Lead communication between technical, operations, engineering, and global leaders, promoting efficient collaboration and respecting cultural differences.
  • Continuously analyze technological, regulatory and business trends, proposing standards and improvements that position as an international reference in sustainable and digital mining.
  • Participate directly in the supplier selection/merger processes, prioritizing interoperability, innovation and return on investment in critical projects.


Requirements and Competencies

Essential Requirements (Hard Skills)

  • Proven experience (minimum of 8 years in IT, with at least 5 as an enterprise architect or similar strategic role in Large Enterprise or mining/resources).
  • Deep knowledge of the mineral, energy or industrial sector, preferably previous experience in large global operations (e.g., Petrobras, Rio Tinto, Barrick Gold, Anglo American).
  • Mastery of the main enterprise architecture frameworks (TOGAF: Practitioner, ArchiMate, Zachman, DAMA-DMBOK).
  • Excellence in the use of cloud technologies (Azure, AWS, GCP) and data platforms, cross-system integration (ERP SAP/Oracle, SCADA, IIoT, Data Lake, Data Warehouse, Lakehouse).
  • Ability to design hybrid architectures (on-premises, cloud, edge), industrial data integration (sensing, automation, dashboards, analytics).
  • Strong performance in compliance, industrial cybersecurity (OT/IT Convergence), data protection, disaster recovery and business continuity.
  • Experience in multinational/cross-border projects, especially Brazil-Canada.
  • Fluent English (technical communication, executive meetings, documentation), advanced Portuguese is a strategic differential for integration between teams.


Soft Skills

  • Advanced communication skills, capable of transmitting complex technical concepts to different audiences (executives, engineers, IT, business).
  • Global strategic vision, aligning local and global initiatives with corporate objectives in sustainable mining, innovation and automation.
  • Analytical and solution-oriented thinking, with high ability to navigate complex, multifunctional and multicultural environments.
  • Collaborative leadership – mentoring, consensus building, influence without direct authority, and excellent internal/external networking skills.
  • Management of priorities, organization and resilience in the face of multiple parallel projects and ad-hoc demands.
  • Absolute focus on results, delivering tangible value for operation, innovation and sustainability.


Differentials / Nice to Have:

  • TOGAF (Expert) certification, AWS/Azure/GCP Solution Architect, CISA, PMP/Agile, specializations in ESG, digital mining, cyber OT/IT.
  • Hands-on experience with emerging platforms: Digital Twins, AI/ML/Ops, real-time streaming (Kafka, Spark Streaming, Flink), infrastructures as code (Terraform, CloudFormation).
  • Experience in due diligence processes, merger & acquisition, integration of multi-company systems.
  • Active participation in architecture forums, mining, global events, technical publications or international presentations.
  • Background with SAP, Oracle, SIEMENS, Rockwell, GE Predix, Azure IoT/Edge/Analytics solutions, sustainability frameworks and ESG reporting.


Expected Skills & Deliverables, Impact:

  • Align the needs of global business, Canada and Brazil with the vision of enterprise architecture and technological roadmap.
  • Ensure that all solutions meet requirements for scalability, security, performance, regulatory compliance and operational excellence.
  • To be an agent of transformation and innovation, proposing disruptive solutions to digital and operational challenges in the mining sector.
  • Mentor and develop technical capacity of the teams, promoting architecture culture, documentation and standardization.
  • Lead the preparation and presentation of business cases, technical justifications and architectural alternatives to senior executives and regional and global boards.
  • Organize, sustain and evolve architecture governance, support strategic decisions and ensure the permanent alignment of solutions with business objectives and international compliance.


Additional Comments:

This is a key role in Canada's technological and cultural transformation, requiring active action in multicultural environments, with flexibility for travel, meetings in different time zones and continuous adaptation to trends in the mining sector and global architecture. The presence of fluent English is mandatory, while mastery of Portuguese enhances Brazil-Canada integration, directly impacting the success of the project. Technical certifications, previous experience in operations, participation in modernization/digitalization initiatives and innovative mindset will be major differentials in the selection process.

- 10年以上人力资源领域工作经验，其中至少5年以上作为区域HR负责人或高级HRBP，全面负责巴西的人力资源管理工作。

- 具备在高速增长、多变的创业环境中工作的成功经验，能够处理模糊性和复杂性。

- 出色的沟通、影响和协调能力，能够与不同文化背景的各级员工和业务领导者有效合作。

- 卓越的战略思维和解决问题的能力，能够将业务需求转化为具体的人力资源举措。


优先考虑：

title: Video Editor
description:
Remote Video Editor:

Candidates must apply with an online portfolio in order to be considered.


WHO YOU ARE:

You are an excellent video editor with good motion design skills looking for a full-time position as part of our team. The ideal candidate has experience on a wide range of marketing projects, specifically that involve graphic/motion work, and is able to translate a variety of assets into exciting and creative video content. You are social media savvy and you know how to create virality in video. You love bringing storyboards to life as well as coming up with your own ideas. You are a result-driven creative person who has great communication skills and is open to others’ feedback and input on your work, as part of a rich creative process.


WHAT WE NEED:

Oddity is looking for a full-time Video Editor/Motion Designer (Remote Contractor) to support our Growth Marketing team. This role will help produce a variety of video ads and video content for Instagram, Tiktok & other online channels. The style of our ads is constantly evolving and we’re looking for someone that has an eye for visuals that are attention grabbing, fresh, and social-friendly

Note - our team works EST hours and candidates should be available during standard business hours.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Be a major contributor and partner in the growth and success of Oddity video content
  • Design, edit & animate short-form video ads for digital channels (Instagram, Facebook, Tiktok, Youtube, etc.)
  • Work closely with marketing managers to bring creative briefs & storyboards to life.
  • Contribute to end-to-end video creative development process, from pre-production to post-production (deliverables)
  • This is a full-time position based remotely.


YOUR QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 5+ years of video editing and motion graphics experience, ideally with marketing video content and/or social media
  • Full proficiency in Abode Premiere and After Effects is a must
  • Familiarity with Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Media Encoder
  • Color-grading experience
  • Strong design skills - must be able to conceptualize & execute visual ideas with typography, graphics, color, and layout.
  • At least basic knowledge and some experience working with AI for video/image generation
  • Strong attention to detail and time management skills
  • Collaborative working style - you're receptive to feedback and direction
  • Has the hustle in order to get tasks done in a timely manner, overcoming challenges along the way
  • This is a remote contract role
  • Full written and spoken english proficiency is a must


BONUS POINTS FOR...

  • Experience working in the beauty, fashion or luxury
  • Experience creating ads for social media (Instagram, Facebook, Youtube, etc.)
  • Videography experience
  • Having a strong eye for graphic design and typography


WHO WE ARE: ODDITY is a consumer tech company that builds and scales digital-first brands to disrupt the offline-dominated beauty and wellness industries. The company serves over 40 million users with its AI-driven online platform, deploying data science to identify consumer needs, and developing solutions in the form of beauty and wellness products. ODDITY owns IL MAKIAGE and SpoiledChild, and are currently working on the development of additional brands.

ODDITY operates with business headquarters in New York City, an R&D center in Tel Aviv, Israel, and a biotechnology lab in Boston. Our culture is fast-paced, innovative, agile, and offers every team member the opportunity to drive a big impact.
